_note: Written by scripts/art/ui/shop_window.mjs --pieces: do not edit by hand. The shop window (D64, D143 to D145), opened on a shopkeeper, in the loot window's family (D248) and the spirit of RuneScape's shops (Michael, 2026-11-20), in the window's pixels, 1152 x 648; "at" is a top left corner, and a piece's "at" already counts its shadow. Draw in the order of "order"; text after the window, the menu and its text over everything. Text is drawn by Godot: "at" is the top left of the line (the top is the font's ascent line), "right" its top right, "centre" its top middle. Every place, size and timing here is a setting. Prices are not decided: every price and count in the draft is made up. The window is one block on the right of the screen: in another window size it would keep to the right (not done).

face._note: The shopkeeper's face, drawn by the game from their character (D121): the Creator character facing S, standing, drawn "scale" times, its top "above" px over the highest pixel, centred on the figure, cut to a circle of "radius" round "centre". Between Portrait Back and Portrait Ring.

slots._note: Each slot: "Slot <material>" at its place, the material of what it holds (Empty when nothing). An item's pack picture (D237): the part "from" of the 256 x 256 picture, drawn "px" wide, its corner "picture" from the slot's. Over a sold-out shop slot: Slot Out. The slot under the pointer, when it holds something: Slot Lit. A pack slot that just got something: Slot New, fading over "new_fade" s. Each overlay's corner is dx, dy from the slot's. A count in the pack (coins, arrows, bandages: D124) right-aligned, its top right "count" from the slot's corner.

shop._note: The shop's stock, 30 slots: a slot's corner is first + step times its column and row. Each slot holding something shows its price centred at "price" and how many are left at "left", both from the slot's corner; sold out, both in their "out" colour and Slot Out over it. Prices and counts come from the server (D143 to D145); a count ticks down after a buy.

pack._note: Your pack: 12 slots, 20 with a backpack (D124). A pack item is sold from its right-click menu; coins never.

note._note: The note on the item under the pointer. Plate Note is drawn for the shop's first row: for another slot it goes down by that slot's top minus the first row's top; its texts are placed from the plate's corner, which is at "corner" for that row. Lines for a shop item: "shop_lines", hint "shop_hint"; for a pack item: "pack_lines" (what the shop pays, or "not_buying", D143), hint "pack_hint". The words are not decided.

menu._note: The right-click menu (RuneScape's way): the item's name, then its lines; a click on a line does it and closes the menu, Esc or a click elsewhere closes it. Plate Menu is drawn for the shop's first slot: for another slot it moves by that slot's corner minus the first slot's ("slot0"); near the right edge it would open to the left (not drawn). Menu Lit lies under the pointed line: drawn for the first line, down "step" a line. "X" asks how many (typing, not drawn). Value shows the price in the note. The words are not decided.

pop._note: When coins change hands: Coin Pop at its place over your coins, rising "rise" px and fading over "time" s, with the amount (minus for a buy, plus for a sale), its top right at "text" from the burst point.

close._note: A click, or Esc, or walking away from the shopkeeper.

says._note: A line the shopkeeper says, picked from their lines (D91); the words are not decided.

coins._note: The shop's own coins (D143), at the right: the coins right-aligned, "Coins" "gap" before them.
coins.label: label

how._note: How to trade: the first part right-aligned at "right", the second from "at".
words: Right click: buy or sell more

pack._note: "Pack", then "filled / slots" "gap" after it; at the right, "Coins" then the coins, the coins right-aligned and "Coins" "gap" before them.
pack.label: label
